content.title: Chapter 98 - TAXATION — Sec. 98-319. - Interest on deficiency.
content.summary:
Any interest on deficiency, including computation, penalty, or jeopardy enforcement,
               shall be enforced in the manner prescribed in
sections 98-71
through
98-73
.
(Code 1981, § 31-138; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
